obfuscation_indicators: strategic changes intended to improve profitability
risk_summary: The disclosure is highly quantified but indicates significant credit and governance risks, including a prior restatement, SEC investigation, shareholder litigation, covenant waiver fees, increased revolver borrowings, and a $14.2 million impairment. Operating performance is pressured by lower gross margins, customer demand declines, government funding constraints, and poor performance at SCB. Management offers some mitigants through new programs, expected ramp-up profitability, and long-term defense demand, but these remain forward-looking and uncertain.
